- Gateway `app-gateway`: `Accepted=True`, `Programmed=True`, listener `http` on port 8000, which matches Traefik's `web` entrypoint (`--entryPoints.web.address=:8000/tcp`).
- Service `app` (port 80 → targetPort 80) with a live endpoint `10.244.0.6:80`; pod `1/1 Running`; nginx config already serves `location /app`.

Patched only the parentRef name on the existing HTTPRoute:

  -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/parentRefs/0/name","value":"app-gateway"}]'
```

No other field (hostnames `app.example.com`, path match `PathPrefix /app`, backendRef `app:80`) was modified.
